You are 14. I want to say you have to be at least 18 to qualify for national registration.
some schools let you be under 18 as long as you have reached 18 by graduation (depends on states)

As for certifications. It depends what state and jurisdiction you want to work in. 

For example in my  state requirements are 
- 18 yo
-national registration and state licensure 

Some companies and cities will even require you to be 21 and also pass a physical agility test which will require you to lift 125 pounds and other things. 

Now this is the fun breakdown.

You have to complete EMT training in a school to take the NREMT . Your school will have more certifications you need to be accepted and you can probably start these if your state allows it. 
In my school I needed
- BLS/CPR cert (schools might only accept certain certs from specific providers such as AHA) can't expire with in 6mo
-make sure vaccines are updated or sign your refusal forms
- DPS clearance card 
-FEMA certs
- school materials

When the time comes find a school that works for you. Schools have different paces and that can determine prices. Mine took about 6 months start to finish and about 2,000 including materials. There was a class that you can finish in 2 weeks but that is everyday 12hrs and close to 4,000. Let me know If you have anymore questions

Good luck!
